hero.headline: Investigations, labs, and projects.
hero.lede: Khalad — cybersecurity graduate focused on digital forensics, incident response, SOC operations, and hands-on security research.

paragraphs: I'm a cybersecurity graduate specializing in digital forensics and incident response. This portfolio documents projects I have built, hands-on labs I have completed, and investigations where I reconstructed activity from forensic artifacts and security logs.
My work spans Windows forensics, memory and disk analysis, log correlation, malware analysis, mobile forensics, network analysis, threat hunting, and offensive-security labs.

labs.title: Cyber Kill Chain Adversary Simulation
labs.description: End-to-end controlled security lab following the attack lifecycle from phishing and initial access through execution, defense evasion, and ransomware deployment on a designated test endpoint.
